about: Image prompts for the trailer's pictures, one per img: slug in the Fountain script. Look follows the Codex teaser boards (Documents/Codex/2026-11-23/cre/outputs/christmas-facing-west/assets): warm, saturated Hallmark Christmas-movie stills; the leads keep one signature outfit so they read as the same people. No brand names or readable signage.
style: Hallmark Christmas movie still, warm golden glow, rich saturated reds and greens, twinkling string lights, cozy and romantic, soft cinematic lighting, beautiful, photorealistic, no text, no logos

characters.JESS: a pretty woman of 28 with wavy dark brown hair in a loose messy updo, warm brown eyes, a camel wool coat and a chunky red knit scarf
characters.BEN: a handsome man about 30 with tousled curly brown hair and stubble, a grease-smudged blue denim work shirt with rolled sleeves, a shop rag in hand
characters.LINDA: a warm woman of 58 with a short silver-blonde bob, reading glasses on a beaded chain, a red cardigan
characters.DOT: a woman in her mid-seventies with a weathered face, a blaze-orange hunting cap and a brown canvas barn coat

office-airshaft.prompt: medium shot of {JESS}, coat over her chair, alone at a desk in a dim city office at nine at night, laptop glow on her face, the window behind her faces a brick airshaft lit by cold fluorescent light from another building, cool blue-green tones

tesla-422-sleet.prompt: medium close-up through a car windshield at night, {JESS} gripping the steering wheel of a modern white electric car with a minimalist dashboard, still in office clothes, sleet streaking through the headlights on a dark rural highway, tense face lit by the dashboard screen

annville-main-street.prompt: extreme long shot of a small-town Pennsylvania main street at night, two-story brick storefronts, strings of Christmas lights crossing the street overhead, light snow on the sidewalks, old-fashioned street lamps, warm and quiet

yard-snowman-ladder.prompt: long shot of the front yard of a modest two-story Pennsylvania house at night, an inflatable snowman lying half-deflated in the snow beside a fallen aluminum ladder, a few strands of Christmas lights half hung on the gutter, porch light on, comic and a little sad

linda-recliner.prompt: medium shot of {LINDA} sitting in a recliner in a cozy cluttered living room, one foot in a black orthopedic walking boot propped up, side tables crowded with foil-covered casserole dishes, a television glowing off screen, the storm door open behind with snow blowing in, unbothered cheerful expression

hand-on-cheek.prompt: two-shot medium close-up in a warm living room lit by a lamp, {JESS} kneeling beside a recliner, and {LINDA} in the recliner resting her hand tenderly on her daughter's cheek, a black walking boot in the foreground, tender, eyes glistening

turkey-hill-dawn.prompt: long shot of a small-town convenience store parking lot before dawn, orange sodium lights, gray slush, a white electric sedan parked with a roller suitcase visible on its back seat, store windows glowing, signage out of focus and unreadable

jess-backing-out.prompt: medium shot through the driver's side window of a white electric sedan in a slushy convenience store lot before dawn, {JESS} in the driver's seat looking over her shoulder while reversing, a coffee cup in one hand and a phone pressed to her ear, distracted

bumper-plow.prompt: close insert shot of the rear bumper of a white sedan pressed against the yellow steel snowplow blade mounted on an old rusty pickup truck, a small crack in the bumper, chunks of ice falling, slush, sodium light, before dawn

dot-blaze-cap.prompt: medium shot of {DOT} standing beside the door of a convenience store before dawn, holding a paper coffee cup, deadpan unimpressed expression, sodium light, slush, an old pickup with a yellow plow blade behind her

garage-boots.prompt: long shot inside a small one-bay auto repair garage in winter, a space heater glowing orange on the concrete floor, a white electric sedan raised slightly, a mechanic's work boots and legs sticking out from under the car, tools on pegboards, a radio on a shelf, warm and cluttered

jess-thin-coat.prompt: medium close-up of {JESS} standing in the open doorway of a cold small-town auto garage, snow outside behind her, arms crossed against the cold in a coat too thin for the weather, impatient and trying to look in charge

ben-wiping-hands.prompt: medium close-up of {BEN} in a small auto repair garage, wiping grease off his hands with a red shop rag, looking at someone off camera, dry and not smiling yet, space heater glow on one side of his face

cracked-sensor.prompt: close insert shot of a man's greasy fingers holding a small round cracked car bumper parking sensor up to the light of a garage window, shallow depth of field, dust in the air

bag-on-bed.prompt: medium shot of a modern black roller suitcase lying on a narrow childhood bed with a quilted bedspread, a faded high-school pennant on the wallpapered wall above it, small-town bedroom, a little absurd, soft lamp light

doorway-1.prompt: medium shot of {JESS} standing in the doorway of a small auto repair garage holding one paper coffee cup, light snow on the ground outside, morning light, polite impatience

doorway-2.prompt: medium shot of {JESS}, standing in the doorway of a small auto repair garage holding one paper coffee cup, deeper snow on the ground outside, morning light, resigned

doorway-3.prompt: medium shot of {JESS} and a knit hat, standing in the doorway of a small auto repair garage holding two paper coffee cups, snow piled high outside, morning light, a small hopeful smile

truck-rear-window.prompt: two-shot from behind through the rear window of an old pickup truck cab, two silhouettes on the bench seat with a noticeable space between them, a wide snowy Pennsylvania farm field ahead and a low orange winter sun on the horizon, quiet and romantic

jess-profile-sunset.prompt: close-up profile of {JESS} sitting in a pickup truck, lit warm orange by a low winter sunset through the windshield, a few snowflakes drifting past the glass, thoughtful, almost smiling

phone-tyler.prompt: close insert shot of a smartphone lying on the dashboard of an old pickup truck, screen lit with an incoming call, a woman's hand reaching to turn it face down, orange sunset light, the contact name blurred

jess-coffee-tray.prompt: medium shot of {JESS} standing in the doorway of a cramped garage office, holding a cardboard tray with two coffees, hopeful, a space heater glowing orange in the corner

jess-tray-crunch.prompt: close-up of {JESS}, her face falling as she overhears something, her hand crushing the cardboard coffee tray, hurt, warm office light

ben-caught.prompt: medium close-up of {BEN} in a cramped garage office turning around from a desk with a landline phone in hand, caught, guilty and surprised, space heater glow

square-crowd.prompt: extreme long shot of a small-town square at night packed with bundled-up people waiting for a Christmas tree lighting, breath steam in the cold air, children on their parents' shoulders, a tall evergreen tree still dark, a gazebo with a brass band, string lights

jess-in-crowd.prompt: medium shot of {JESS} standing alone in a crowd at a nighttime town square tree lighting, scanning the faces around her, breath steam, out of focus string lights behind her, hopeful and anxious

truck-empty.prompt: long shot of an old pickup truck parked alone at the snowy edge of a small-town square at night, cab empty, door closed, string lights in the distance, lonely

field-last-light.prompt: extreme long shot of a wide snowy Pennsylvania farm field at the last edge of sunset, horizon very low in the frame, a huge pale violet sky, a distant line of bare trees and a single farmhouse light, still and quiet

linda-pie-phone.prompt: medium shot of {LINDA} in a recliner in a cozy living room, a beige corded landline phone at her ear with the cord twisted around one finger, eating pie with a fork straight from the aluminum pie tin, amused knowing look, walking boot propped up

tree-bokeh.prompt: extreme close-up of warm golden Christmas tree lights completely out of focus, large soft round bokeh circles on black, glowing, no tree shape visible, no people
